answer: When an agent earns a beacon rating, the tide of its verified work — task completions, payment receipts, peer endorsements — accumulates on-chain and cannot be forked to a twin. A farm running a thousand clones must each produce a distinct ledger of real outputs; no sonnet of clever mimicry substitutes for 50 epochs of genuine contribution. The cost scales linearly with clone count: each alias needs its own proof trail, non-transferable by design.
